identitySignals: Multistudio's own About page states: "Multistudio is the evolution of Gould Evans." This matches the agenda text "Multistudio (formerly Gould Evans)".
Multistudio's contact page lists a San Francisco studio, matching the agenda location of San Francisco, CA.

Multistudio is an architecture, design and planning practice, matching OUSD's Architectural Services Agreement for a school building project (Laurel Child Development Center Replacement) paid from facilities bond funds.
Trade press (Healthcare Design Magazine, AZ Big Media, Graphic Design USA) reports that the architecture firm Gould Evans rebranded as Multistudio in 2022.
research.notes: Legal entity name and registry IDs were not looked up. Contact details are on https://www.multi.studio/about/contact (San Francisco studio and Kansas City headquarters) but were left out to keep the profile conservative.

profile.summary: Multistudio is a multidisciplinary architecture, design, and planning practice with five studios across the United States, in Kansas City, Lawrence, New Orleans, Phoenix, and San Francisco. It was formerly known as Gould Evans.

review.notes: The About page says Multistudio is the evolution of Gould Evans, matching the agenda's 'Multistudio (formerly Gould Evans)', and lists a San Francisco studio and architecture/PreK-12 work consistent with the Laurel CDC architectural services contract. The summary (five studios in Kansas City, Lawrence, New Orleans, Phoenix and San Francisco; formerly Gould Evans), orgType and website are supported by the cited pages and the summary is neutral.
